motion_rule: the washing line is hauled through frame all clip, so she walks the wire against it to hold her place; laundry, the nest and the sparrow stream past her a wing away and swat the lens; the camera rides at her level, new shot size every beat, never wider than her head filling a third of frame, one action per beat, all travel across frame, never up or down
character: a slim grey turtle dove, pink breast, black neck ring, head stabbing the air
second_characters: ONE sparrow with nothing on him: rides a peg past the lens, swings in on a pillowcase
props: ONE red thread from her toe to a coin nest pegged on the moving line; ONE rolled banknote
prop_continuity: the thread runs taut from 0.50 on; the banknote rides down it at 5.55 and slaps her face at 7.25
environment: sunlit yards packed with washing lines, sheets crossing at every depth, an open window hauling the line
light_events: blazing noon, wet sheets bouncing white light on her

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: soft cooing female voice gone hard, preaching, biting each word, 4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ot-LO-zhish, CHOR-ny, pri-DYOT, CHOR-na-ya, DEN-gi, spa-SUT, TOL-ko, KRY-lya
audio.pacing: 0.95-2.70, 3.10-4.65 and 5.05-7.25 each one breath; after 7.25 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her beak opens wide and shapes every syllable, throat swelling
audio.sfx: wind, sheets cracking, the pulley squealing, coins dropping

timeline.a: a wet sheet rides the line into the lens and swats past, uncovering her
the thread snaps taut and tows her sideways; she digs in and walks against it
she paces the wire against the crawling line, laundry streaming past her shoulders
a pillowcase fills with wind and barges between her and the lens
she puffs her throat out; a towel whips across frame a wing from her
the sparrow rides a peg past the lens and knocks her off her step
she walks on as the coin nest crawls away from her along the line
a sheet peels off at the lens and rakes across the whole frame
she turns her head sharp to profile while the nest tows her a step back
the sparrow swings in on a pillowcase, brushes the lens, and she ducks
she hauls forward against the thread, throat swollen
the banknote runs down the thread and thumps into her breast; she walks on with it wedged there
she rises on her toes, wings half open, as the yard streams past
she throws both wings wide and pushes off the wire, straight over the lens
the thread yanks her back into the lens: upside down by one toe, wings hammering, beak snapping at the camera, the banknote across her face
the nest swings down the line into her face and dumps coins past the lens one at a time
she snaps at the sparrow as he rides past her upside-down head and misses
the line carries her and the empty nest out of frame, still swinging

must_appear: the red thread runs from her toe to the nest and tows her; every line is spoken, the last word by 7.25; at 7.25 she hangs upside down at the lens beating her wings and snapping, alive and furious; coins leave one at a time
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a wide shot, an empty yard, a dead or limp bird, wings hanging loose, a thread on her neck, a parked camera, a closed beak while speaking, slow motion, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters
